learningTip: Perhatikan kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable) seperti research, evidence, advice, information.
learning_tip: Perhatikan kata benda tak terhitung (uncountable) seperti research, evidence, advice, information.

prompt: Identify the error: The advisory board for riverine macroinvertebrate health [insisted] that the tourism board [submits] its [updated] protocols [without] delay.
explanation: Setelah kata kerja tuntutan seperti 'insisted that', kata kerja klausa berikutnya harus berupa kata kerja dasar murni tanpa akhiran -s, yaitu 'submit'.
learningTip: Setelah kata kerja mandasif (insist/recommend/suggest that), gunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar murni.
learning_tip: Setelah kata kerja mandasif (insist/recommend/suggest that), gunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar murni.

prompt: Identify the error: At the renewable energy keynote, the senior [investigator] [which] [directed] the the biotechnology unit project [received] widespread acclaim.
explanation: Subjek 'the senior investigator' merujuk pada orang, sehingga kata ganti penghubung yang tepat adalah 'who', bukan 'which'.
learningTip: Gunakan 'who' untuk manusia dan 'which' untuk benda mati atau konsep.
learning_tip: Gunakan 'who' untuk manusia dan 'which' untuk benda mati atau konsep.

prompt: Identify the error: During the library services symposium, the newly appointed [director] [were] confident that the public health syndicate would [reach] its [targets].
explanation: Subjek 'the newly appointed director' berbentuk tunggal, sehingga to be lampau yang tepat adalah 'was', bukan 'were'.
learningTip: Kenali inti subjek sebelum preposisi untuk menentukan apakah tunggal atau jamak.
learning_tip: Kenali inti subjek sebelum preposisi untuk menentukan apakah tunggal atau jamak.

prompt: Identify the error: In the conservation initiative for groundwater management, if the ornithology station [completes] the study, it [will publishes] the [summary] next [month].
explanation: Setelah modal auxiliary 'will', kata kerja harus berbentuk dasar murni ('publish'), bukan 'publishes'.
learningTip: Modal auxiliary selalu diikuti bare infinitive (kata kerja bentuk pertama tanpa akhiran -s).
learning_tip: Modal auxiliary selalu diikuti bare infinitive (kata kerja bentuk pertama tanpa akhiran -s).

prompt: Identify the error: Regarding institutional feedback on bilingual cognitive flexibility, the [revised] estimate proved to be [more closer] to the [actual] count than the preliminary [figure].
explanation: Kata 'closer' sudah merupakan bentuk komparatif; penambahan 'more' menciptakan double comparative yang tidak baku ('closer', bukan 'more closer').
learningTip: Hindari penggunaan double comparative (jangan gabungkan more dengan akhiran -er).
learning_tip: Hindari penggunaan double comparative (jangan gabungkan more dengan akhiran -er).

prompt: Identify the error: For the regional delegation on urban gardens, the housing association spent several [months] [to develop] a comprehensive [curriculum] for local [institutions].
explanation: Pola ekspresi waktu 'spend time' diikuti oleh gerund ('developing'), bukan to-infinitive ('to develop').
learningTip: Ingat pola: spend + time/money + V-ing.
learning_tip: Ingat pola: spend + time/money + V-ing.

prompt: Identify the error: In the publication review of road safety, the research [paper] [publishing] by the engineering faculty [won] first prize at the national [symposium].
explanation: Makna kalimat membutuhkan past participle pasif 'published' ('yang diterbitkan'), bukan present participle aktif 'publishing'.
learningTip: Bedakan V-ing (aktif/yang melakukan) dan V3 (pasif/yang dikenai) pada reduced relative clause.
learning_tip: Bedakan V-ing (aktif/yang melakukan) dan V3 (pasif/yang dikenai) pada reduced relative clause.

prompt: Identify the error: During the preliminary examination of archival preservation, the executive committee resolved the [dispute] by [themself] before [consulting] external [advisors].
explanation: Bentuk reflexive pronoun untuk subjek jamak 'the executive committee' adalah 'themselves', bukan 'themself'.
learningTip: Reflexive pronoun untuk third person plural adalah themselves.
learning_tip: Reflexive pronoun untuk third person plural adalah themselves.

prompt: Identify the error: Within the strategic framework for sustainable forestry, the team is looking [forward] to [receive] official [feedback] from the heritage society this [week].
explanation: Dalam frasa idiomatis 'look forward to', kata 'to' berfungsi sebagai preposisi sehingga wajib diikuti gerund ('receiving'), bukan 'receive'.
learningTip: Catat ekspresi di mana 'to' adalah preposisi (look forward to, be used to, object to + V-ing).
